title: Source dependency scanning
responsibility: Extracts literal and uncertain module references from script, Svelte and CSS source.

inputs.name: scanImports.code
inputs.description: Source text to scan for module references.

inputs.name: scanImports.language
inputs.description: Source family: ts scans scripts, svelte scans its script blocks, css scans quoted @import references, and other returns no references.

inputs.name: svelteScripts.code
inputs.description: Svelte source from which script-block contents should be extracted.

outputs.name: scanImports
outputs.description: References with specifier or null, via and typeOnly, plus a short detail for computed calls. Script references are source-ordered and deduplicated by kind/specifier or detail; member calls are excluded.

outputs.name: svelteScripts
outputs.description: Contents of matched script blocks in source order, excluding tags.
